On its US opening day, *Casino Royale* was on top with $14.7 million; throughout the weekend, it grossed a total of $40.8 million, ranking narrowly second behind *[Happy Feet](/wiki/Happy_Feet "Happy Feet")*.[[103]](#cite_note-104) However, *Casino Royale* was playing in 370 fewer cinemas and had a better average ($11,890 per cinema, against $10,918 for *Happy Feet*).[[104]](#cite_note-105) It earned $167.4 million by the end of its run in North America,[[4]](#cite_note-BOM-CR-4) becoming the highest-grossing film of the series, before being surpassed by *[Quantum of Solace](/wiki/Quantum_of_Solace "Quantum of Solace")*'s $168.4 million.[[105]](#cite_note-106)

On 18 November 2006, *Casino Royale* opened at the first position in 27 countries, with a weekend gross of $43.4 million in the non-UK, Irish, US and Canada markets.[[106]](#cite_note-107) The film retained the top spot at the worldwide box office for four weeks.[[107]](#cite_note-108) The film earned $167.4 million in the United States and Canada and $438.6 million from international territories, for a total of $606 million worldwide. It was the fourth-highest-grossing film of 2006.[[108]](#cite_note-109) It was the highest-grossing instalment of the *James Bond* series until *[Skyfall](/wiki/Skyfall "Skyfall")* surpassed it in November 2012.[[109]](#cite_note-110) After subsequent re-releases, it has earned over $616 million.[[4]](#cite_note-BOM-CR-4)

Chichen Itza, a UNESCO [World Heritage Site](/wiki/World_Heritage_Site "World Heritage Site"), is the second-most visited of Mexico's archeological sites.[[102]](#cite_note-108) The archeological site draws many visitors from the popular tourist resorts in [Cancún](/wiki/Canc%C3%BAn "Cancún"), who make a day trip on tour buses.

In 2007, Chichen Itza's Temple of Kukulcán (El Castillo) was named one of the [New Seven Wonders of the World](/wiki/New_Seven_Wonders_of_the_World "New Seven Wonders of the World") after a worldwide vote.[[103]](#cite_note-Hindustan_times-109) Despite the fact that the vote was sponsored by a commercial enterprise, and that its methodology was criticized, the vote was embraced by government and tourism officials in Mexico who projected that as a result of the publicity the number of tourists to Chichén would double by 2012.[[nb 7]](#cite_note-110)[[104]](#cite_note-111) The ensuing publicity re-ignited debate in Mexico over the ownership of the site, which culminated on 29 March 2010 when the state of Yucatán purchased the land upon which the most recognized monuments rest from owner Hans Juergen Thies Barbachano.[[105]](#cite_note-112)

INAH, which manages the site, has closed a number of monuments to public access. While visitors can walk around them, they can no longer climb them or go inside their chambers. Climbing access to El Castillo was closed after an American woman fell to her death in 2006.[[62]](#cite_note-DiarioYucatan3Mar06-66)

All landed on the surface only once, and five missions consisted of two or more surface [extravehicular activities (EVAs)](/wiki/Extravehicular_activity "Extravehicular activity"). Four of them are alive as of February 2026 with an average age of 92.9
years. Most astronauts at that time came from the military services and were considered to be on active duty during their NASA service. The few exceptions were considered civilian NASA astronauts, regardless of any prior military service.

On the last of their three Apollo 17 EVAs, [Harrison Schmitt](/wiki/Harrison_Schmitt "Harrison Schmitt") stepped out of the [Apollo Lunar Module](/wiki/Apollo_Lunar_Module "Apollo Lunar Module") onto the surface of the Moon after [Gene Cernan](/wiki/Gene_Cernan "Gene Cernan"), and is therefore the 12th and most recent person to have stepped out onto the Moon. When they re-entered the Lunar Module Cernan stepped in last, and is therefore the last person to have walked on the Moon.

[Alan Shepard](/wiki/Alan_Shepard "Alan Shepard") was the oldest person to walk on the Moon, at age 47 years and 80 days. [Charles Duke](/wiki/Charles_Duke "Charles Duke") was the youngest, at age 36 years and 201 days.
